exposure: Infant feeding advice/updated infant feeding and allergy prevention guidelines
Earlier introduction of common food allergens (peanut, egg, cow's milk)
cohort: The study included two cohorts of infants (n=506 born 2006-2014; n=566 born 2016-2022), all of whom had a first-degree relative with a history of allergic disease.
finding: Direct provision of updated food allergy prevention guidelines facilitated earlier introduction of allergens and significantly reduced the prevalence of IgE-mediated peanut, egg, and cow's milk allergies at 1 year of age.
